claims.text: CoinDesk published a report on November 2, 2022 revealing Alameda Research's balance sheet was heavily reliant on FTT tokens
Binance announced on November 8, 2022 that it would sell its FTT holdings, triggering a run on FTX
FTX filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy on November 11, 2022; Sam Bankman-Fried resigned as CEO and John J. Ray III was appointed
Sam Bankman-Fried was arrested in the Bahamas on December 12, 2022 at the request of US authorities
Sam Bankman-Fried was convicted on all seven counts of fraud and conspiracy on November 2, 2023

outcome.summary: FTX filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in November 2022 after customer funds were found to have been misused. CEO Sam Bankman-Fried resigned and was later arrested in the Bahamas. He was extradited to the US and convicted on all seven counts of fraud and conspiracy in November 2023. The collapse led to increased regulatory scrutiny of the cryptocurrency industry.

title: Sam Bankman-Fried resigns as FTX CEO
trigger: FTX, a cryptocurrency exchange, collapsed after revelations that customer funds had been commingled with Alameda Research, a trading firm also owned by Sam Bankman-Fried. SBF resigned as CEO when FTX filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy.
